jobs.title: Data Analyst, New Grad
jobs.description:
Jobright is your personal AI job search agent that transforms the way you do job search from solo, time-consuming efforts to a fast, expert-guided journey, simplifying every job search step and accelerating your route to the best job outcomes. As a Data Analyst, New Grad, you will work onsite with product, engineering, and AI teams to turn product, job market, and user data into insights that directly influence product development.

Why Join Us

• Build real, production AI agents used by real users
• High ownership and impact
• Work at the intersection of AI, agents, and product
• Shape how people experience AI-driven job search

Responsibilities

• Analyze product, user, and job market data to identify trends and opportunities
• Write SQL queries and build reports, dashboards, and analytical tools
• Define and monitor key product and business metrics
• Support A/B tests and evaluate new product features
• Investigate data quality issues and improve reporting accuracy
• Present findings to product, engineering, and business stakeholders
• Collaborate closely with the team in an onsite environment
Qualification

Required

• Recent graduate or graduating soon in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field
• Strong SQL skills and familiarity with spreadsheets or Python
• Understanding of basic statistics, data analysis, and experimentation
• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work onsite in the SF Bay Area

Preferred

• Experience with pandas, scikit-learn, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools
• Familiarity with product analytics, recommendation systems, or search
• Experience working with large or messy datasets
• Previous internship, research, or analytics project experience

jobs.title: Field Technician
jobs.description:
Since 1952, Kiely Family of Companies has been building lasting relationships and delivering innovative design-build solutions that put our customers’ success first. Founded by John F. Kiely Sr., we have grown into a diversified group of companies whose unique capabilities enhance one another, making us greater than the sum of our parts.

Recognized on the ENR 400, 500, and 600 lists for engineering and construction excellence, KIELY is a leading design-build, construction, and engineering services provider specializing in infrastructure solutions for the natural gas, water and wastewater, electric, industrial, commercial, and midstream pipeline industries. Our integrated engineering and construction teams deliver turnkey solutions — from initial design and permitting through construction, commissioning, and ongoing support — helping customers build, maintain, and modernize critical infrastructure.

Our culture is built on teamwork, technological innovation, and the highest ethical standards. We refer to our employees as team members because together we empower, partner, and advance—serving a purpose far greater than any individual project. Kiely team members are an elite group of behind-the-scenes professionals who embody our core values and are dedicated to making a meaningful impact.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Field Technician to provide surveying and construction layout support for utility and industrial projects. The ideal candidate will have experience with survey equipment and CAD software or a strong desire to learn and advance within the surveying profession.

Responsibilities

Recording survey measurements and descriptive data using notes, drawings, sketches, and inked tracings
Perform survey calculations
Travel to various jobsites to obtain necessary survey data and jobsite information
Prepare CAD mapping using varying applications
Compile information necessary to stake projects for construction, using engineering plans
Field survey client assets and operate various equipment from different manufacturers including Trimble
Scheduling and communicating workload status to Project Manager in order to meet all deadlines
Perform boundary staking to establish or re-establish boundary lines
Operate and use GPS surveying equipment
Perform layout work competently and accurately as specified by the Project Manager
Perform any other duties as assigned by management

Competencies

Familiarity in CAD and Civil 3D programs
Experience with field data collection
Self- motivated, have strong imitative and desire to learn and advance in the survey profession
Strong math and logical reasoning skills
Ability to understand land access and ROW acquisition issues
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to organize work, engage in a variety of tasks simultaneously and consistently meet deadlines

Benefits And Compensation

Position offers competitive pay, benefits, paid vacation, and health/dental insurance.

Full-time: $23.08 - $31.25 hourly, based on experience and qualifications.

Equal Opportunity Employee, M/F/D/V

The Kiely Family of Companies is a growing and dynamic company actively seeking applications and resumes from exceptional candidates. Whether you come equipped with years of experience in the underground utility field—or you’re ready to work hard and get there—we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Our Client
The organization operates within the artificial intelligence research sector, focusing on advancing generative AI technologies. It manages complex, cross-functional research and training data programs that bring together research leaders, technical teams, and domain experts to support the development of innovative AI systems.
About the Opportunity
The Project Coordinator
supports AI research and operational initiatives by coordinating workflows, communications, and project activities across program leadership, research teams, and domain experts. This role helps keep projects organized and on schedule while tracking deliverables, identifying risks, and facilitating collaboration throughout the project lifecycle.
Responsibilities
• Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for AI data and research projects, keeping workflows organized and on schedule.
• Collaborate with program leads and subject-matter experts to translate project requirements into clear, actionable instructions.
• Support the onboarding, coordination, and engagement of domain experts as projects expand.
• Participate in weekly business reviews, maintain meeting notes and action items, and facilitate project calls as needed.
• Monitor project quality, identify issues, investigate root causes, and communicate findings to stakeholders.
• Assist research and product teams in developing and refining project processes, standards, and guidelines.
• Identify risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks and coordinate resolutions with relevant stakeholders.
• Track milestones, deliverables, and performance metrics using tools such as Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel.
• Maintain accurate project documentation and ensure timely follow-up across teams.
• Adapt workflows, processes, and priorities as project requirements evolve.
Requirements
• Must be based in the United States.
• STEM educational background strongly preferred.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience in project coordination, project management, or program operations involving cross-functional collaboration.
• Experience coordinating large teams or complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
• Hands-on experience with AI training data, human data, machine learning, or AI research projects is highly desirable.
• Previous experience as a Project Coordinator, Team Lead, EPM, or Program Coordinator supporting AI or data initiatives is advantageous.
• Experience supporting AI or data programs within technology-driven organizations is preferred.
• Strong data management skills, including proficiency with Excel and SQL.
• Working knowledge of coding or technical concepts, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical teams.
• Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
• Proven ability to lead, coordinate, or manage large groups effectively.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and adapt to a fast-changing environment.
Pay Range and Compensation Package
• Compensation of $45–$55 per hour
.

Equal Opportunity Statement: Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator - Power Delivery
jobs.description:
About Our Client
The organization operates in the power delivery sector, supporting large-scale projects across the Northeastern United States. It focuses on delivering efficient and reliable power infrastructure while addressing complex project management, documentation, and coordination requirements. Through strong operational practices and cross-functional collaboration, the organization helps clients successfully execute critical power delivery initiatives.
About the Opportunity
The Project Coordinator - Power Delivery
supports project teams by coordinating the administrative, logistical, and documentation activities required for successful project execution. This role helps maintain project workflows, track milestones, manage records, and facilitate communication among internal teams, clients, vendors, and other stakeholders. The position contributes directly to project efficiency, documentation accuracy, and compliance.
Responsibilities
• Lead or assist Project Managers with project setup and administrative coordination.
• Develop and maintain project logs, schedules, financial reports, and status reports.
• Coordinate client deliverables to ensure consistency, accuracy, and compliance with requirements.
• Manage project documentation, including contracts, financial reports, RFIs, and Change Orders.
• Track project milestones, deliverables, and assigned tasks and follow up as needed.
• Administer internal documentation systems and maintain appropriate version control.
• Serve as a primary point of contact for project-related administrative inquiries.
• Collaborate with Procurement and Finance teams on budgets, purchasing activities, and invoice approvals.
• Assist with data entry for cost reports, timesheets, vendor submissions, and other project records.
• Facilitate project meetings and distribute agendas, notes, action items, and follow-up materials.
• Support onboarding of project staff by coordinating required access, documentation, and resources.
• Identify administrative and logistical challenges and recommend process improvements.
• Update project dashboards, tracking systems, and reporting tools.
• Support audits and compliance reviews by compiling, organizing, and maintaining required records.
• Maintain documentation related to safety, quality assurance, and regulatory requirements.
• Contribute to the development and improvement of project templates, procedures, and workflows.
• Monitor the use of shared project resources to ensure alignment with project requirements.
• Lead administrative coordination for large projects involving multiple offices and stakeholders.
• Mentor junior staff on project coordination procedures and best practices.
• Anticipate and escalate risks related to schedules, documentation, deliverables, or compliance.
• Track deliverable cycles and support timeline, quality, and completeness checks.
• Adhere to organizational policies, ethical standards, and applicable project requirements.
• Perform additional duties as assigned.
Requirements
• High school diploma or equivalent.
• Minimum of 5 years of relevant post-education experience.
• Strong understanding of project lifecycles and project coordination practices.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities independently and meet deadlines.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office and project tracking tools such as Smartsheet or Microsoft Project.
• Experience with documentation management platforms such as SharePoint or Procore.
• Knowledge of contract, invoicing, procurement, and related administrative controls.
• Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
• Ability to interpret and implement project coordination policies, procedures, and standards.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Experience preparing tailored reports for project stakeholders.
• Demonstrated ability to identify and implement process improvements.
• Ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams and stakeholder groups.
• Strong problem-solving, organizational, and time-management skills.
• Experience managing documentation for subconsultants, contracts, permits, and related project records.
• Commitment to maintaining confidential information.
• Proven experience coordinating medium- to large-scale projects.
• Ability to lead documentation audits and coordinate data-gathering activities.
• Willingness to support the development of junior staff.
• Demonstrated reliability and accountability.
Pay Range and Compensation Package
• The pay range and compensation package for this role will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and other relevant factors.
Equal Opportunity Statement: Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

jobs.title: Furnishings Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Hybrid | Athens or Atlanta Area Preferred

Overview

Hawthorne House is a physical and remote, to-the-trade showroom open to the public, serving designers, decorators, homeowners, and other clients throughout the East Coast. Founded in 2003, we have built lasting relationships with trade partners and private clients through our curated furnishings, decorative lighting, and personalized service. While our showroom is located in Athens, Georgia, the majority of our business is generated remotely through project and trade relationships.
We are seeking an experienced Furnishings Specification & Project Coordinator
to support furnishings and lighting projects from proposal through procurement, delivery, and installation.
This is not a design position.
It is a highly organized, client-facing coordination role with a strong emphasis on communication, administration, scheduling, documentation, procurement follow-through, and keeping multiple projects moving accurately and on time.
Experience in the interior design, furnishings, decorative lighting, procurement, or related trade industry is strongly preferred.
This is a hybrid position, with candidates in the Athens or Atlanta area preferred
. The role will combine remote work with in-person collaboration, client meetings, and occasional travel to the Hawthorne House showroom and project sites.
Responsibilities

Serve as a primary point of communication for clients throughout the quoting, ordering, procurement, delivery, and installation process.
Provide timely, clear project updates and proactively follow up on outstanding questions, approvals, schedules, and next steps.
Communicate and coordinate with trade partners, vendors, receivers, installers, and internal team members.
Prepare furnishings and lighting quotes, proposals, specifications, and purchase orders.
Track projects from approval through ordering, production, receiving, delivery, and installation.
Confirm pricing, availability, lead times, freight, COM requirements, and vendor acknowledgments.
Maintain accurate project schedules, order status, budgets, and documentation.
Track and reconcile purchase orders, vendor invoices, client payments, credits, and project costs.
Schedule meetings, deliveries, installations, and other project-related appointments.
Identify potential problems early, communicate concerns promptly, and help develop solutions before issues become emergencies.
Assist in resolving damages, backorders, shipping issues, and other project challenges.
Support Hawthorne House leadership and the Outside Sales Specialist with project coordination and follow-through.

Qualifications

Three or more years of relevant experience in interior design, furnishings, procurement, project coordination, decorative lighting, or a related field preferred.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and confidence interacting directly with clients.
Working knowledge of furniture and lighting specifications, purchase orders, trade pricing, lead times, COM, freight, receiving, delivery, and installation.
Strong administrative, scheduling, and project-coordination skills.
Experience maintaining and reconciling project budgets and purchasing records.
Exceptional organization, accuracy, and follow-through.
Ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
Proactive, resourceful, deadline-oriented, and calm under pressure.
Strong problem-solving skills with a completion-focused mindset.
Proficiency with spreadsheets, Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, Adobe Acrobat, and project-management systems.
Experience with Monday.com or interior design purchasing software is preferred.

Growth Opportunity

For a high-performing candidate, this position offers a natural path into Project Management
, with increasing responsibility for client relationships, budgets, procurement, schedules, installations, and overall project completion.
Compensation

Compensation is commensurate with experience.
To Apply

Submit your résumé and cover letter to jobs@hawthornehouseinc.com
with “Furnishings Specification & Project Coordinator”
in the subject line.

new_jobs.title: Furnishings Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Hybrid | Athens or Atlanta Area Preferred

Overview

Hawthorne House is a physical and remote, to-the-trade showroom open to the public, serving designers, decorators, homeowners, and other clients throughout the East Coast. Founded in 2003, we have built lasting relationships with trade partners and private clients through our curated furnishings, decorative lighting, and personalized service. While our showroom is located in Athens, Georgia, the majority of our business is generated remotely through project and trade relationships.
We are seeking an experienced Furnishings Specification & Project Coordinator
to support furnishings and lighting projects from proposal through procurement, delivery, and installation.
This is not a design position.
It is a highly organized, client-facing coordination role with a strong emphasis on communication, administration, scheduling, documentation, procurement follow-through, and keeping multiple projects moving accurately and on time.
Experience in the interior design, furnishings, decorative lighting, procurement, or related trade industry is strongly preferred.
This is a hybrid position, with candidates in the Athens or Atlanta area preferred
. The role will combine remote work with in-person collaboration, client meetings, and occasional travel to the Hawthorne House showroom and project sites.
Responsibilities

Serve as a primary point of communication for clients throughout the quoting, ordering, procurement, delivery, and installation process.
Provide timely, clear project updates and proactively follow up on outstanding questions, approvals, schedules, and next steps.
Communicate and coordinate with trade partners, vendors, receivers, installers, and internal team members.
Prepare furnishings and lighting quotes, proposals, specifications, and purchase orders.
Track projects from approval through ordering, production, receiving, delivery, and installation.
Confirm pricing, availability, lead times, freight, COM requirements, and vendor acknowledgments.
Maintain accurate project schedules, order status, budgets, and documentation.
Track and reconcile purchase orders, vendor invoices, client payments, credits, and project costs.
Schedule meetings, deliveries, installations, and other project-related appointments.
Identify potential problems early, communicate concerns promptly, and help develop solutions before issues become emergencies.
Assist in resolving damages, backorders, shipping issues, and other project challenges.
Support Hawthorne House leadership and the Outside Sales Specialist with project coordination and follow-through.

Qualifications

Three or more years of relevant experience in interior design, furnishings, procurement, project coordination, decorative lighting, or a related field preferred.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and confidence interacting directly with clients.
Working knowledge of furniture and lighting specifications, purchase orders, trade pricing, lead times, COM, freight, receiving, delivery, and installation.
Strong administrative, scheduling, and project-coordination skills.
Experience maintaining and reconciling project budgets and purchasing records.
Exceptional organization, accuracy, and follow-through.
Ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
Proactive, resourceful, deadline-oriented, and calm under pressure.
Strong problem-solving skills with a completion-focused mindset.
Proficiency with spreadsheets, Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, Adobe Acrobat, and project-management systems.
Experience with Monday.com or interior design purchasing software is preferred.

Growth Opportunity

For a high-performing candidate, this position offers a natural path into Project Management
, with increasing responsibility for client relationships, budgets, procurement, schedules, installations, and overall project completion.
Compensation

Compensation is commensurate with experience.
To Apply

Submit your résumé and cover letter to jobs@hawthornehouseinc.com
with “Furnishings Specification & Project Coordinator”
in the subject line.
